name: pqc-khepra-mcp
displayName: PQC-Khepra MCP — CMMC Autopilot & AI Flight Recorder
description: Post-quantum secure MCP server for CMMC compliance scanning, STIG validation, NIST 800-53 cross-mapping, and AI agent observability. Built on KHEPRA Protocol (USPTO #73565085). 36,195 cross-framework compliance mappings. ML-DSA-65 signed attestation packages. FIPS 140-3 compatible.

tools.name: ert_scan
tools.description: Enterprise Risk & Threat scan. Runs full STIG/CMMC/NIST 800-171 compliance scan and returns findings with cross-framework mappings.

tools.name: stig_check
tools.description: Check a system path or configuration against RHEL-09-STIG controls.

tools.name: nist_map
tools.description: Map CCI identifiers or STIG findings to NIST 800-53 Rev 5 controls across 36,195 pre-computed mappings.

tools.name: cmmc_assess
tools.description: Assess a system or artifact against CMMC Level 1, 2, or 3 practices.

tools.name: godfather_report
tools.description: Generate a dollar-denominated executive Godfather Report from prior scan results. Shows financial impact per finding.

tools.name: attest_export
tools.description: Export a PQC-signed (ML-DSA-65 / NIST FIPS 204) attestation package for C3PAO intake or audit evidence.

tools.name: agent_record
tools.description: Send AI agent actions to SouHimBou AI Flight Recorder for tamper-evident capture and PQC-signed storage.
